title: Steve's ATV Rentals

services.name: Kids' ATVs
services.desc: For beginners, we recommend the Honda 250 semi-automatic or the Kymco 300 automatic. On the Honda 250, you will have to shift gears with your left foot. The Kymco 300 auto is very simple with just gas and brake. Shifting is not required. We have great instructors that will show you how to operate these vehicles and they require no experience to ride it. Pismo Beach has a beach staging area that has all of our rentals. This staging area is a mile and a half down the beach from the rental office.
